predecessors.name: Third Dynasty of Ur
predecessors.text: 'The province of Isin broke out and formed an independent kingdom under Ishbi-Erra'

successors.name: Larsa
successors.text: Isin, seized by Rim-Sin I 'around 1792 BC'

ledger.x: 2018 BCE: Ishbi-Erra makes Isin an independent kingdom.
2008 BCE (bridged): Isin takes the provinces around it.
1983 BCE: Ishbi-Erra ousts the Elamite garrison from Ur.
1932 BCE (bridged): Lagash province goes with Larsa's governor.
1923 BCE: Gungunum of Larsa takes Ur.
1797 BCE: Rim-Sin I invades Isin's territory.
1792 BCE: Isin falls; 'every year name of his rule after was named in years after the sack of Isin'.
1792 BCE: Rim-Sin I of Larsa takes Isin and ends the dynasty.

wars.name: Isin–Larsa rivalry
wars.outcome: Gungunum took Ur and broke with Isin; Abisare and Sumuel cut Isin's canals; Nippur was lost; Rim-Sin I invaded in c.

wars.name: Expulsion of the Elamites from Ur
wars.outcome: Ishbi-Erra's victory over the Elamites in his 16th year and the later ousting of the garrison from Ur; Ur became Isin's.

certainty.note: City territories and canals, no surveyed border; the division of Sumer between Isin and Larsa is this dossier's reading of the pages.
